deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 15 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Log Change Token\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 15` output filtered to the `Log Change Token` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; captures token text but assumes simple persistence and omits log-change semantics/context.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; correctly adds a state-transition model and no-log-mutation boundary but lowers capability for pending inputs.

original_test_intent: Verify the Type 15 Log Change Token is a well-formed value that remains stable while the event log is unchanged and changes according to the approved semantics when reboot legitimately updates the log; exact equality is not inherently required.
original_method: Capture the raw token with Type 15 identity/status/layout plus a read-only event-log snapshot immediately before and after the approved reboot, determine whether content changed and evaluate token transition without clearing or injecting events.
manual_activity: A user approves token transition semantics, read-only log correlation and reboot plan. No event injection or log clearing is allowed.
required_inputs: Raw token format/width and platform transition rule
Approved read-only representation or digest of associated log content/state
Policy for events normally generated during reboot
Rules for wraparound, initialization or implementation-specific constant tokens
Validated parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not clear, rotate, write or inject log entries; preserve the original state and any reboot-generated evidence.
Preserve raw token bytes and record identity; a formatted value alone may conceal width/endian details.
Do not fail an explained token change or pass an unchanged token when correlated log content changed contrary to policy.
Use only approved read-only log access and do not assume BMC SEL is the same store.
Stop on malformed token, unexplained token/log relation or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw token and approved log-state evidence, classify whether the log changed and evaluate the token transition before/after reboot.
Do not mutate logs, generate test events or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve token/log transition, wraparound and reboot-event policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, adjudicate unexplained transitions and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field selector is relevant, but simple text diff cannot establish whether token equality/change is correct without correlated log state and raw token provenance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 15 records and timestamped read-only log state/digest; evaluate the raw token transition against whether the associated log changed.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Log Change Token scope, Type 15 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve raw token and approved log-state digest at closely bounded timestamps, determine log change across reboot and test the platform's unchanged/changed/wraparound relation rather than fixed token equality.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 15 System Event Log implementations exposing a change token.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, log implementation and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 15 Log Change Token semantics, approved platform log transition policy and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces blind persistence diff with raw, state-correlated transition analysis and evidence preservation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage for stale tokens, legitimate reboot changes and unexplained transitions without requiring log mutation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Token format and associated log-change model.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Concurrent firmware events can race collection; timestamps and bounded snapshots are required, and exact event content may be inaccessible through SMBIOS alone.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a token change caused by documented reboot events or wraparound, but must retain pre/post raw tokens and correlated log evidence; it cannot clear the log to simplify the result.
expected_evidence: Approved token format/change/wraparound and reboot-event policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 15 record with raw token, status/layout/access fields and timestamped read-only log state/digest
Complete post-reboot equivalent evidence and explicit changed/unchanged correlation
Approved reboot/health evidence without log mutation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The criterion requires the token to remain correct after reboot, not necessarily numerically unchanged; a state model resolves the dynamic semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw token and log-state correlation are safely automatable once the platform transition policy is supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects blind equality, adds raw/token width and associated log-state transition evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its state-model/no-mutation safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates project transition policy, approved reboot and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Avoids false failure for legitimate reboot events and false pass when a stale token fails to change with the associated log.
independent_technical_reasoning: The token and read-only log state are software-readable; their approved transition relation can be evaluated deterministically without generating or clearing events.
